reviews.title: Sturdy well produced
reviews.comment: Exactly what you'd expect from Cable Matters—solid build quality and reliable performance. The connectors are secure and the wiring is durable. Perfect for custom builds or extending power reach without any voltage drop issues.
reviews.author: Ben Hancock

reviews.title: Worked out well
reviews.comment: Great extension cables, easy to install and sorted my issue.  Moved my old rig into a new case, stupidly didn't think about the reposition of my power supply. As such power cables didn't reach the mobo socket, got these as a 2 pack just in case and worked out perfectly. More than enough length to get the job done, no power loss or issues using both together.
reviews.author: Mark whalley

reviews.comment: You get exactly what you pay for. Two nice little extension cables
reviews.author: Camilo

reviews.title: They are not bad, just be careful.
reviews.comment: Bought these for system builds to use as extenders to the MOBO 4-pin connector. I knew I should have been more mindful that due to the price (which is very nice) that there might be some issues, and there was only one--durability. Taking them out of the package one of the wires/connectors came loose out of the housing that connects to the motherboard. I feel like this could have been avoided had the wires been sleeved and maybe a little non-conductive adhesive been used. But that would have brought the cost up. Sent them back got replacements and the new ones were fine. (I also made sure not to man-handle them out of the plastic bag.) Once I connected them they worked just fine. If you buy them just be very careful taking them out of the plastic bag they're in. You might end up doing what I did and making one of the connectors useless.
reviews.author: Stoneweaver28

reviews.title: These work just fine
reviews.comment: I bought these because I needed one to create a Y-harness for some equipment so I would not have to alter the "factory" cable. It worked perfectly. As a bonus, I needed another cable for a two-conductor harness, which I tried with this four-conductor and the two-conductor connector fits perfectly, using half of the conductors. The value is good, I suppose, the "thickness" is great, whatever the hell that means. I have no idea how "sheerness" applies to a power extension cable, so I left that unrated.
reviews.author: xyz
